sources.detail: All 6 registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 195-343 KB decompressed (sizes read off disk, never curl's size_download, which reports the compressed length under --compressed); r.jina.ai deliberately not attempted, it is IP-403 on this host. <style> stripped BEFORE parsing since the tier-list CSS ships inline, and <table class="tier-list"> asserted at EXACTLY 1 per page. Letter taken from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster — the first-alt rule is what excludes the spell-icon alts inside the expandable detail blocks. Counts reconciled BEFORE any merge: raid 27/7/6 = 40 and M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, every letter inside the registered 7-band icyveins scale. ZERO letters moved — all 80 are byte-identical to stored. Every page's JSON-LD dateModified is unchanged from the stored published value (raid DPS 2026-08-30, raid healer 2026-09-01, raid tank 2026-08-29, M+ DPS 2026-08-30, M+ healer 2026-08-30, M+ tank 2026-08-30), which is the honest explanation for a static parse; published values were re-read rather than carried forward and none moved, including the raid-tank page corrected to 08-29 by the 09-04 run. Era-verified from each body and changelog, not a substring count: all six self-identify as Midnight Season 2 / Patch 12.1 and Devourer is present in the four DPS and tank lists. The Season 1 hits are retrospective prose ("a less powerful version than Season 1") and the raid-healer page's title still reading (Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight) is overridden by its Season 2 body, per the blue-tracker body-over-title precedent. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six, so no value changed and freeze-season had nothing to observe.

Both registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 159 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 166 KB decompressed. Parsed from tier__tier / tier__title / data-original-title and resolved by ROSTER MATCH, never by container position. The roster match is again what rejects the M+ page's second tierlist — its eight entries are the dungeon-difficulty blocks (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale) and none maps to a spec, which is exactly the 8 unmatched labels reported. Raid 40/40, M+ 40/40, 0 spec rows unmatched. ZERO letters moved. The pages' own 'Last Updated' lines are unchanged at 10th August 2026 (raid) and 13th August 2026 (M+) — read out of the .last-updated paragraph itself, not a nearby date — which is the honest explanation for a static parse. Era-verified from the ranking bodies: both self-identify as Midnight and both carry all three Demon Hunter specs including Devourer, so there is no season question; seasonVerified stays s2. Method carries no published field in the registry, so there is nothing to cross-check against the published-evidence artifact.

All 6 registered pages fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 75-341 KB decompressed; r.jina.ai deliberately not attempted, it has been IP-403 on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03. Recipe exactly as recorded: unescape \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST, then find the [tier-list=rows] … [/tier-list] block — never anchor on WH.markup.printHtml, the raid-healer page carries a 1.2 KB decoy call — segment on [tier-label …]X[/tier-label] with tolerant whitespace, and resolve each [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. Exactly one tier-list block per page; raid 27/7/6 = 40, M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 0 unmatched slugs, 0 duplicate-tier conflicts. ZERO letters moved, and every page's dateModified is unchanged from the stored published value — raid 2026-08-31 on all three, M+ DPS 2026-08-28, M+ healer 2026-08-26, M+ tank 2026-09-01 — so a static parse is what a static page should produce. Era: all six bodies self-identify as Season 2 and the four DPS/tank pages carry Devourer; Devourer is correctly absent from the two healer pages. seasonVerified stays s2.

Not reachable — the archon.gg wall, night 12 (opened 2026-08-25/26). All 11 distinct registered archon.gg URLs were fetched fresh this run with the full browser header set: every one returned HTTP 403 carrying Cloudflare's "Just a moment..." challenge-platform interstitial (6,054-6,159 bytes) with __NEXT_DATA__ count 0 and zero "Human Verification" text — the same 403 shape as nights 10-11 rather than the 200-plus-verification-body form the required-sources label records, which is exactly why the assertion was made on __NEXT_DATA__ presence and not on the status code. No attempt was made to solve, replay or automate past the check, and nothing was backfilled from Warcraft Logs: Archon's letters are its own tiering and its numbers its own percentile cuts, so publishing ours under the archon source id would fabricate the source. Stored letters, numbers, encounter tiers and every archon page snapshot left byte-identical; the consensus stays Icy Veins + Method + Wowhead, "consensus of 3".

FETCHED AND DIFFED, nothing to merge — upstream has not re-run since 2026-09-01. Two plain curl calls, no headers, no proxy, no auth: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json HTTP 200 (snapshotDate 2026-09-01, completedAt 2026-09-01T22:25:20Z, Last-Modified Tue 01 Sep 2026 22:55:42 GMT) and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 162 KB (Last-Modified Tue 01 Sep 2026 22:23:28 GMT). The two agree, which is NOT the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest shape, and the payload was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest anyway: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField lowerBound + keyRange undefined gives 27+7+6 = 40 rows (melee and ranged deliberately excluded as dps SUBSETS, which is what a blacklist of 'dungeon' alone would double-count), and all 40 lowerBound values are byte-identical to stored at the stored 1-decimal precision. Nothing merged, so the coverage date correctly does not move and the row is partial rather than success — the stored date is 4 days behind the run. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED of 2026-08-21 continuing: upstream is frozen, not our fetch, and it clears when WoWMeta re-runs. wowmeta.com HTML was not fetched — it is a stale S3 prerender.

MERGED 13 MOVED ROWS UNDER THE SOURCE'S OWN LAGGING DATE — the WoWMeta 2026-08-04 precedent, not a success. All three meta pages by plain browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 41-71 KB (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok and was not attempted). 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 rows parsed, 0 unmatched, 0 without a value. The page's own date is the machine-readable <time datetime> on each page, NOT the rendered 'Updated N hours ago' string, which is server-rendered at build and here reads 1-7 hours against real cut times ~67 hours old — taking the visible text would have stamped today on three-day-old numbers. Those timestamps show the DPS page unchanged at 2026-09-02T10:10:21Z while the healer and tank pages have re-cut to 2026-09-02T18:17:55Z and 18:18:12Z (the 09-04 run recorded all three at 10:10:2xZ). The data agrees exactly with that split: all 27 DPS ratings are byte-identical to stored, and 13 of 13 healer+tank rows moved — Restoration Shaman 3625->3630, Holy Paladin 3625->3629, Holy Priest 3489->3492, Mistweaver 3479->3484, Preservation 3426->3423, Restoration Druid 3369->3370, Discipline 3291->3292, Blood DK 3630->3635, Guardian 3569->3566, Brewmaster 3537->3536, Protection Paladin 3521->3532, Vengeance 3447->3451, Protection Warrior 3442->3432. Largest relative move 0.3%, far under maxValueMovePct 0.6, and all 40 rows were re-upserted at the source's stated date of 2026-09-02. Because that date is unchanged the coverage date does not advance, so this is partial by the success cross-check's own rule; maxAgeDays is 5, so it does not yet trip the staleness gate.

MERGED 23 PROFILES from a genuinely fresh re-sim. All 27 DPS specs requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 retries each: 23 returned real charts and the same 4 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on 3/3 retries each — Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, the identical set recorded since 2026-08-31 (Augmentation absent by design). Every one of the 23 carries simc_settings.tier = MID2 read off the chart, never hard-coded, and ptr as the STRING "0" compared explicitly rather than truthily, so the pool is tier-uniform against the stored MID2 pool and the uniformity guard is satisfied; composition is unchanged at 23, so nothing was dropped and the row-drop gate is not engaged. asOf is each CHART's own timestamp, not the run date: all 23 now read 2026-09-05 (previously 21 at 09-02 and 2 at 09-03), so upstream re-simmed the whole pool overnight. All 138 target values at counts 1/2/3/5/8/15 moved, max relative move 4.54% — ordinary re-sim drift, nowhere near maxValueMovePct 0.6, so no value_move_ack is needed. Coverage date advances 2026-09-02 -> 2026-09-05 with 23 profiles against the floor of 15.

MERGED 23 rows from a genuinely fresh sim. MID2_Raid.txt HTTP 200, 1.36 MB, Last-Modified 2026-09-05T07:28:33Z, and it HAS a 'DPS Ranking:' block (at line 58, directly under the header) so the .html fallback was not needed and the in-progress generation log further down is not the report. Era-verified off the report's own header build string rather than the visible version, which is the Highcharts number: 'SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69587 Live (hotfix 2026-09-04/69587, git build HEAD aa9de89aac, no-networking)' — the HEAD hash moved from the stored run's 7d86fb9c3a, which is the freshness detector and the honest explanation for values moving at all. 44 ranking lines mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed (MID2_Demon_Hunter_Havoc_Fel-Scarred and MID2_Death_Knight_Frost_Rider both resolve), best hero-variant per spec, leading 'Raid' aggregate row skipped: 23 of 27 DPS specs, the 7 unmapped lines being tank profiles (Protection Warrior, Protection Paladin x2, Brewmaster, Vengeance, both Blood builds) which are correctly excluded. Augmentation absent by design; Balance, Feral and Devastation still have no MID2 profile upstream, so the 23-row pool is unchanged in composition and nothing was dropped. Moves are small and uniform — 23 of 23 rows moved, max 0.11%, family median 240089 -> 239944 — i.e. iteration noise, far under maxValueMovePct 0.6. asOf 2026-09-05.

MERGED 39 rows. /period/latest HTTP 200, 206 KB, resolving to period 1079 — the same weekly period as the last two nights ('Period 1079 MID2', Lindormi's Guidance / Xal'atath's Bargain: Devour / Fortified / Tyrannical / Xal'atath's Guile) — but the window is rolling and 22 of 39 values changed. Parse BOUNDED to the 'Spec representation in top keys' <figure> and read per <li> from the img alt plus the <span class="mt-1"> value, never a 'first percentage in the block' regex (the bar's height:NN.NNNN% style precedes the value); scanning the whole page would have returned the Classes-and-specs and per-dungeon repeats instead. Labels normalised on [-\s]+ so 'devourer demon-hunter' and 'unholy death-knight' resolve: 39 rows, 0 unmatched. Shape-checked BEFORE merging, which is the only thing that separates this column from the /meta per-key-presence one: the series sums to 100.2 with role subtotals Ranged+Melee 60.3 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 19.9, i.e. the ~30/30/20/20 representation share. FIRE MAGE IS ABSENT FROM THE CHART THIS PERIOD — 39 rows, not 40. That is a legitimate upstream absence, not a parse failure: it was published at 0.0 on 09-04 and other 0.0 specs (Frost Mage, Augmentation, Discipline) are still listed, so it was dropped upstream rather than missed here. Its stored row is 0.0 and was left standing at its 2026-09-04 date rather than being invented at today's — the group still sums to the same 100.2, so no stale share is being carried. 39 rows against the floor of 25 and a 2.5% row change, well inside maxRowDropPct. All values are below minValueMagnitude 100, so the relative-move guard correctly does not apply to a percentage that legitimately swings 0.3 -> 0.1. asOf 2026-09-05.

ALL FOUR CHANNELS POLLED; ONE NEW LIVE-12.1 ENTRY LOGGED. (1) Wowhead news RSS: HTTP 200, 205 KB, 40 items parsed per <item> block, newest 2026-09-05 08:00. (2) Wowhead news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) polled as well because the index leads the RSS: 20 posts, newest id 382757 at 2026-09/05 08:00. (3) Wowhead blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries, newest 2026-09-04 20:23, no standalone class-tuning blue post — only the hotfix mirrors and the 12.1.5 PTR notes. (4) The canonical source read directly: Kaivax's running hotfix topic 2336376, now titled 'World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes - September 4', post 1 at version 31 last edited 2026-09-05T01:21:46Z, read with its heading structure INTACT. LOGGED: a new 2026-09-04 kind:hotfix entry with the Balance Druid line (Stellar Amplification cooldown-manager tracking; Twin Moons' range increased by target combat reach) and the non-class round-up. Its classification was CHECKED, not assumed: classifyHighlight scores the consolidated Balance line as a BUFF on the range increase, and that vote is left standing rather than reworded — editing a highlight to steer the tally would be gaming the outlook. DELIBERATE, RECORDED OMISSION: the same round-up carries 'Enhancement Shaman — Corrected an issue where the Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus was not properly increasing the upfront damage of Crash Lightning.', which is real 12.1 PvE tuning and belongs in the entry, but it TOUCHES A SET BONUS. The tier-set upkeep gate then requires Enhancement Shaman's tierSet.asOf to advance to 2026-09-04, and since the 2026-08-23 two-page rule that also requires gearing/data/specs.json to be re-synced — and gearing/ never travels in the nightly refresh artifact (publish stages data/, dist/ and skill logs only), so a nightly-side bump is structurally unpublishable. Verified in-run rather than assumed: bumping the tracker alone reds validate with 'gearing/data/specs.json: Enhancement Shaman tierSet.asOf does not match data/specs.json', and syncing the mirror would be dropped at publish and red Gate 1 there. OWNER ACTION for a local run: bump Enhancement Shaman's tierSet asOf/source, run node gearing/src/sync-tracker-fields.mjs && npm run gearing:build, and add the line plus Enhancement Shaman to the 2026-09-04 entry — the 2026-09-03 Holy Priest and 2026-09-02 Fire Mage precedents. Opening a cycle is an OWNER action — a new PHASES.ptr entry, a new thread key, contract rows and a zone probe — not an agent-side thread-key update; PHASES.ptr is still null, so nothing 12.1.5 was written anywhere. The dormant WCL PTR zone sweeps (52/54/56/57) were correctly not attempted; their contract rows were removed at the flip.

All 44 transcribable channels carrying a channelId polled via the YouTube RSS endpoint, 0 failures, 15 entries each = 660 videos, media:description parsed alongside the title. Seen-set recomputed from structured data only (pending-transcripts seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] plus every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url), never by regex over log prose: union 1230, 288 unseen and all 288 in-cycle against the computed bound of 2026-06-18 (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, taken as a date and not an index). DISTILLED both pre-fetched transcripts — transcript-fetch/summary.json verdict 'ok', requested 2 fetched 2, no API or YouTube call made from this session. (a) MadSkillzzTV MivlWUZEWOY '12.1 Best Healers (so far) | M+ & Raid Healer Balance' (2026-09-04): 11 bracket-scoped takes across all seven healer specs, raid and M+ split because his reads genuinely diverge — Mistweaver and Holy Paladin tier-set-limited in raid but fine to strong in keys, Discipline the mirror image, Holy Priest his surprise of the patch in both, Preservation S-tier raid and an underrated key healer, Restoration Druid a raid sleeper, Restoration Shaman a melee-comp specialist under the new set. The Archon M+ tier list shown on screen is explicitly not his own ('This is not my tier list') and was not distilled. (b) Dalaran Gaming A1PXCqNKAdo (2026-09-01), a 2h key-running stream: ONE take, his repeated own-voice read that Beast Mastery Hunter is cracked after its buffs (M+). His Frost DK and Demonology remarks are second-hand speculation ('apparently') and outside his registered scope, and the Font of Venomous Rage discussion is an item-level, explicitly hearsay claim — all triaged out. 11 older takes superseded, same creator + spec + SAME LENS only, so his 09-01 'both'-scoped Restoration Druid read and Dalaran's 08-29 'both' Beast Mastery read stay live rather than being retired by a narrower successor. Queue rewritten honestly: both distilled ids removed from videos[] (neither sat in seen[] or skipped[], so no weaker lane record to drop), and 2 new keyword-filtered candidates queued for the paid drain — Ze7qcYHcbvg (Obli, 'After the buffs, which DPS DK spec is better in Raid?', 2026-09-04, description confirms a Frost-vs-Unholy raid comparison and Obli is the registered Frost/Unholy DK specialist) and l6bJ-pcX-h4 (izen, 'How HARD Are M+ Season 2 Keys?', 2026-09-03, the generalCreators metaNotes lane). Both verified against the live RSS with an author match. The remaining 286 unseen were left UNSEEN rather than marked seen: they are budget and relevance cuts, not durable dismissals — the Supatease PvP block, gameplay PoVs, boss and gearing guides, and the 12.1.5-changes videos that have no lane until the owner opens that cycle. npm run audit:creators: 0 HIGH, 0 MED, 9 INFO. Creator `latest` refreshed for Dalaran Gaming (5 entries); MadSkillzzTV`s six entries are `managedBy: "overrides"`, so apply-community-overrides restored the owner-pinned text at prebuild and the agent edit is correctly a no-op — community-overrides.json is owner-curated and was not touched.
